58 likes, 3 comments - momspresso on June 13, 2023: "My son and I switched roles for a day. Let’s see how it unfolded! The task he thought was the most difficult “laundry” turned out to be the easiest- how?

All thanks to our new Samsung #AIEcobubble washing machine, a cleaning innovation like no other! My little one was surprised to know that we can control this #washingmachine from anywhere using the #smartthings app! Just a click and your wash cycle is set! How amazing, no?

From soiled clothes to muddy socks, this innovative #AIEcobubble smart washing machine can tackle any stubborn stain and make your clothes, as good as new! It has a powerful Ecobubble technology that can convert detergent into bubbles, which quickly penetrates into the fabric and removes all the ingrained dirt. 

Its AI technology is redefining the laundry game with the personalized washing feature that remembers our washing habits and even suggests cycles! Step into the future of cleaning with this #SamsungEcobubbleWashingMachine for an effortless laundry routine! 

#samsungindia #powerofbubbles #AIEcobubble #washingmachine #smartthings #laundry #ad #collab #hygienesteam #clothes #workingmom #mominfluencer #momblogger".
